_about: The Professor's selection rule (reports/professor_design.md; the parameters from reports/professor_rule.md, research-query runs 39950331744 and 39950972382, ledger professor-rule-1023). Among the horses the syndicate holds at select_at UK (the live rule's own backs), advise each whose advised bookmaker price clears the closing model's expected BSP by overlay_bar, at most max_per_race a race, ranked by the expected win probability (p_pool in the ledger), at most max_tips a day; ranks 1..free_tips are the free tips.

compliance.basis: Advised prices are the best price available at three or more major bookmakers at publication. Results are proofed to the advised price and to the Betfair SP at 1 point level stakes; take the early price, the SP loses.
compliance.position: The Professor's syndicate holds a position on every horse advised before it is published.
